sales_order_to_cash_trace.description: Trace a sales order to receipt: each row is a path from an original order line through subsequent logistics lines, invoice lines and receipt application lines. Only identities, dates and statuses are provided, with no summable quantities or amounts. Keep separate paths for logistics before invoicing, direct order invoicing, and reserve invoices before logistics; absent successors remain null. One order may be fulfilled in parts, one invoice may combine orders, and one invoice may have multiple receipts. Path counts are not document counts. Locate the source by order_entry/order_line, without guessing from item codes or displayed document numbers. Canceled records remain; select each stage's status for the question. A receipt here means an explicit invoice application in RCT2, not all internal reconciliations, down-payment offsets or cash settlement. Read amounts from the separate invoice receipt application details. Standalone documents without an order source are outside this View.

sales_invoice_receipt_applications.description: Invoice receipt application details: one row is RCT2.DocNum+InvoiceId, with InvType=13 restricting the invoice class. DocNum is the parent ORCT.DocEntry internal key, not its displayed number; identify the invoice by DocEntry. SumApplied/AppliedFC/AppliedSys are stored at application-line grain. Do not repeat invoice or receipt header totals or expand by invoice item lines. Interpret FC in the target invoice currency, never the payment header currency; obtain LC/SC codes separately from OADM.MainCurncy/SysCurrncy in the same company. Do not sum FC across currencies. Discounts, withholding tax and differences are separate components; the applied amount is not the cash actually received or paid. Preserve cancellation status. Other document types, later internal reconciliation of on-account payments and down-payment offsets are outside this View; no application row does not imply the invoice is unsettled. The raw DocLine does not define an allocation to item lines.

sales_invoice_current_balance.description: One row per invoice DocEntry, showing the current header total, paid amount and their difference without expanding item or payment lines. PaidToDate and related fields are booked paid amounts, not specifically cash. The difference does not replace complete historical aging that accounts for credit memos, down-payment offsets, internal reconciliations and localization-specific cases. There is no historical cutoff dimension; do not assign current values to past dates. Canceled, reversal and reserve invoices are not excluded automatically; select status and role for the question. Obtain LC/SC currency codes separately from the same-company OADM; group FC by DocCur. Preserve NULL instead of replacing unknown values with zero.

purchase_order_to_payment_trace.description: Trace a purchase order to payment: each row is a path from an original order line through subsequent logistics lines, invoice lines and payment application lines. Only identities, dates and statuses are provided, with no summable quantities or amounts. Keep separate paths for logistics before invoicing, direct order invoicing, and reserve invoices before logistics; absent successors remain null. One order may be fulfilled in parts, one invoice may combine orders, and one invoice may have multiple payments. Path counts are not document counts. Locate the source by order_entry/order_line, without guessing from item codes or displayed document numbers. Canceled records remain; select each stage's status for the question. A payment here means an explicit invoice application in VPM2, not all internal reconciliations, down-payment offsets or cash settlement. Read amounts from the separate invoice payment application details. Standalone documents without an order source are outside this View.

The raw DocLine does not define an allocation to item lines.

production_issue_detail.description: Production issue details: one row is IGE1.DocEntry+LineNum. Production shares OIGE/IGE1 with ordinary inventory documents; BaseType=202 selects a production source. Use header DocDate as the actual date, without truncating by production-order dates. Preserve the source row if the order does not match; the original BaseLine identifies the source component, not the current LineNum. Keep item type 4/resource type 290, historical units, cancellation status and stored amounts. StockSum is the document line inventory amount, not a signed OIVL warehouse journal amount. Verify the company-local-currency and inventory-unit conditions of StockPrice against the current semantics. Do not sum quantities across items or units. Do not apply ABS or change signs automatically for returned components or reversals.

production_receipt_detail.description: Production receipt details: one row is IGN1.DocEntry+LineNum. Production shares OIGN/IGN1 with ordinary inventory documents; BaseType=202 selects a production source. Use header DocDate as the actual date, without truncating by production-order dates. Preserve the source row if the order does not match; the original BaseLine identifies the source component, not the current LineNum. Keep item type 4/resource type 290, historical units, cancellation status and stored amounts. StockSum is the document line inventory amount, not a signed OIVL warehouse journal amount. Verify the company-local-currency and inventory-unit conditions of StockPrice against the current semantics. Do not sum quantities across items or units. Production receipts may represent returned components, disassembly components or rejected quantities, so they cannot all be totaled as finished-product output. Database TranType codes C/R are not the SDK enumeration values 0/1.

inventory_batch_serial_movements.description: Batch/serial inventory movement details: one row is ITL1.LogEntry+ItemCode+SysNumber. Include only OITL.StockEff=1 on-hand effects, excluding committed/ordered allocation logs for the same document. ManagedBy distinguishes batches 10000044 from serial numbers 10000045; join the corresponding master through its unique item-plus-system-number key. Keep the raw signed inventory-unit Quantity without ABS or another negative multiplier; it is not document-unit quantity. Doc/Apply are distinct roles and both remain visible; do not combine them with OR and double count. A document line may have multiple logs and batches; keep both transfer sides. Interpret LocCode with LocType. Preserve facts and null display numbers when batch/serial master data is unmatched. Ordinary unmanaged items are outside this View.

signed_inventory_quantity.displayName: Raw Signed Batch/Serial Inventory Movement Quantity

sales_delivery_batch_serial_detail.description: Sales delivery batch trace: one row is a delivery line plus the ITL1 log/item/system-number identity. Bind the original delivery line by OITL.DocType=15 and DocEntry/DocLine/ItemCode; include only StockEff=1 to avoid duplicating commitment logs for the same delivery. Provide signed inventory movement quantity, normally negative for an ordinary issue. Preserve cancellation records and both Doc/Apply roles. Cover only delivery stock effects in the log-document role; do not fabricate actual delivered batches from Apply-only records or ordinary items without a log. Special reserve-invoice, cancellation and return flows require verification against the target company's inventory actions and SAP.

signed_inventory_quantity.displayName: Raw Signed Batch/Serial Inventory Movement Quantity

inventory_bin_movements.description: Historical bin transactions: one row is OBTL.AbsEntry. The bin and batch/serial come from the same original allocation row; do not expand them independently by document line and multiply them. MessageID joins OILM, BinAbs joins OBIN, and SnBMDAbs joins the batch or serial master together with OILM.SnBType and ItemCode. Preserve ordinary items, -1 values and facts with unmatched master data. raw_bin_quantity is the original OBTL.Quantity, without a standardized sign: actions 1/19 are inbound, 2/20 outbound, and the rest other. Do not apply ABS, change signs again or treat this as a verified net movement quantity. Keep AccumType, action and direction separately, including both transfer sides. Do not copy message-level quantities or amounts onto every bin and sum them. Verify direction and quantity signs against the target company's inventory transactions.

master_entry.displayName: Batch Or Serial Master Record ID

inventory_bin_current_balance.description: Current total item inventory by bin: one row is OIBQ.AbsEntry, with item-plus-bin unique. Include the item-level totals for batch/serial-managed items; do not add their batch/serial bin components again. Zero and negative balances remain. Warehouses without bin management are outside this table. There is no historical date dimension, so it cannot answer stock at a past point in time. The unit is the item's current inventory unit and must not replace historical transaction units.

inventory_batch_serial_bin_current_balan.description: Read batch and serial balances separately by management type and combine them with UNION ALL. The row key is management_type+balance_entry; the two sets of AbsEntry may overlap. Current batch/serial-by-bin components must not be added to OIBQ item totals. There is no historical cutoff dimension and this is not a movement ledger. Preserve zero and negative values and facts with unmatched master data. Displayed batch numbers are not guaranteed unique; filter with item and management type. Interpret quantity by item and current inventory unit, read from current OITM.InvntryUom. This does not identify a historical unit, and current active/inactive settings do not remove balances.

master_entry.displayName: Batch Or Serial Master Record ID

inventory_batch_serial_warehouse_current.description: Read batch and serial balances separately by management type and combine them with UNION ALL. The row key is management_type+balance_entry; the two sets of AbsEntry may overlap. Current batch/serial-by-warehouse balances include warehouses without bins; warehouse and bin balances are different levels and must not be added together. There is no historical cutoff dimension and this is not a movement ledger. Preserve zero and negative values and facts with unmatched master data. Displayed batch numbers are not guaranteed unique; filter with item and management type. Interpret quantity by item and current inventory unit, read from current OITM.InvntryUom. This does not identify a historical unit, and current active/inactive settings do not remove balances.

master_entry.displayName: Batch Or Serial Master Record ID

inventory_warehouse_current_balance.description: One row is OITW.ItemCode+WhsCode, with current warehouse totals and projected availability OnHand-IsCommited+OnOrder. This is not immediately pickable stock, batch/serial detail, bin detail or historical inventory. Do not add the batch/serial components at this level again; aggregate quantities by item and inventory unit. Preserve zero and negative values. Master-data names and units are current settings.

finance_journal_line_detail.description: One row is JDT1.TransId+Line_ID; journal headers and account names do not increase the line count. posting_date/document_date/due_date read OJDT header dates; line_posting_date/line_document_date/line_due_date (the line_ prefix) read JDT1 line dates. Use the corresponding fields for header-date or line-date analysis, without filling one from the other. Debit, credit and debit-minus-credit retain stored signs; do not apply ABS or infer profit/loss direction from account names. Project comes from the line; query the source separately for the header project. Obtain LC/SC codes from the same-company OADM, group FC by FCCurrency and do not total different foreign currencies directly. Reconciliation participant rows are not expanded and reversal records are not excluded. This is not a historical aging or cash-flow report.
